sentences.text: Supernatural is an American fantasy horror television series created by Eric Kripke .	Eric Kripke	Eric Kripke	fantasy	fantasy
It was first broadcast on September 13 , 2005 , on The WB , and subsequently became part of successor The CW 's lineup .	The WB	The WB	The CW	The CW

Starring Jared Padalecki as Sam Winchester and Jensen Ackles as Dean Winchester , the series follows the two brothers as they hunt demons , ghosts , monsters , and other supernatural beings .	Jared Padalecki	Jared Padalecki	Jensen Ackles	Jensen Ackles	Sam Winchester	Sam Winchester	Dean Winchester	Dean Winchester	demons	demons
The series is produced by Warner Bros. .
Television , in association with Wonderland Sound and Vision .	Wonderland Sound and Vision	Wonderland Sound and Vision

Along with Kripke , executive producers have been McG , Robert Singer , Phil Sgriccia , Sera Gamble , Jeremy Carver , John Shiban , Ben Edlund and Adam Glass .	Robert Singer	Robert Singer (producer)	McG	McG	John Shiban	John Shiban	Phil Sgriccia	Phil Sgriccia	Sera Gamble	Sera Gamble	Ben Edlund	Ben Edlund	Jeremy Carver	Jeremy Carver	Adam Glass	Adam Glass	executive producers	executive producers
Former executive producer and director Kim Manners died of lung cancer during production of the fourth season .	Kim Manners	Kim Manners	fourth season	Supernatural (season 4)

The series is filmed in Vancouver , British Columbia and surrounding areas and was in development for nearly ten years , as creator Kripke spent several years unsuccessfully pitching it .	British Columbia	British Columbia	Vancouver	Vancouver

The pilot was viewed by an estimated 5.69 million viewers , and the ratings of the first four episodes prompted The WB to pick up the series for a full season .	The WB	The WB	pilot	Pilot (Supernatural)
Originally , Kripke planned the series for three seasons but later expanded it to five .
The fifth season concluded the series ' main storyline , and Kripke departed the series as showrunner .	fifth season	Supernatural (season 5)	showrunner	showrunner

The series has continued on for several more seasons with new showrunners , including Sera Gamble , Jeremy Carver , Robert Singer and Andrew Dabb .	Robert Singer	Robert Singer (producer)	Sera Gamble	Sera Gamble	Jeremy Carver	Jeremy Carver	Andrew Dabb	Andrew Dabb
With its eleventh season , Supernatural became the longest-running American fantasy series .	fantasy	fantasy
The series was renewed for a twelfth season , which aired from October 13 , 2016 , to May 18 , 2017 .
On January 8 , 2017 , The CW renewed the show for a thirteenth season .	The CW	The CW
